source.title: Evercore Zoomshroud – Wowhead 12.1.7 PTR item comments
source.author: Grimmella (comment)

quote: They disenchant nicely into 1 or 2 radiant shards
notes: Grimmella copy-posted essentially the SAME general firsthand-sounding observation under all four Evercore engineering goggle variants (244751, 244752, 244753, 244754). This is ONE commenter/source family, NOT four independent casts/cohorts or an instrumented per-operation study. Claimed 1–2 Radiant Shards is a reported qualitative amount, not a verified conditional distribution; observed min/max per linked 244751 cannot be proven independently. Comment date, actual equip/DE itemLink, build, disenchant-time ilvl, spec, skill, total operations, hit/zero counts, output rank/ID unknown. This PTR page's displayed item level 44 is NOT an observed cast ilvl. Existing midnight-20261031-1506 reports WoWDB base template cannotDE for this same item: eligibility contradiction, do not override without live-client test.
